title: Zucchini Ranch Meatloaf
description: This zucchini meatloaf made with Cheddar cheese and ranch dressing is moist and delicious. It’s a great way to sneak some veggies into weekday dinners.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Lightly grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.

Mix ground beef, ground turkey, Cheddar cheese, bread crumbs, zucchini, onions, bell pepper, egg, ranch mix, and Worcestershire sauce in a large bowl until well combined. Form mixture into a loaf and place in the middle of the prepared baking dish.
Stir ketchup and steak sauce together in a small bowl until well combined; pour over meatloaf.
Bake in the preheated oven until no longer pink in the center, about 1 hour. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C).

video.description: Sneak some veggies into the meatloaf and watch everyone—even those picky eaters—clamor for more—seriously! Make your meatloaf mixture with a combination of ground beef and turkey, and shredded zucchini, onion and green bell pepper for an awesome, moist texture. Then bind it all with egg and infuse the flavor with Worcestershire sauce, Cheddar cheese, bread crumbs and ranch dressing mix. Make a rich sauce out of ketchup and steak sauce and spread over the top, then bake until done. Then slice it up thick and serve with mashed potatoes and peas and make the entire family happy for dinner. Don’t forget to save some for next-day meatloaf sandwiches!
